Commentary.Commentary: Lets go. The umpires and the players are out on the field. Fazalhaq Farooqi to start the attack for Afghanistan. Muhammad Waseem and Khalid Shah to open the batting for the United Arab Emirates. Let's Play!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, the United Arab Emirates to walk out and chase 204 runs in their quota of 20 overs on a wicket that looks exceptional for batting. Will they be able to chase it down? Or will the Afghanistan bowlers be a little too much for them to handle? Let's find out. The run chase coming your way soon.

Ali Naseer comes for a quick chat after the first innings. He says that it is a good experience playing in front of this crowd. Adds that it was first outing and hopes that his team can chase this target. Tells that it is a good total but if they bat deep and use the ground conditions and dimensions, they can get over the line. Mentions that taking pace off worked a lot on this wicket and that will be key. Says that his journey has been great with making his debut against West Indies here and got back-to-back fifties as well. Ends by saying that he always tries to learn from senior players playing in ILT20 and that's has helped him a lot.

However, the United Arab Emirates found themselves on the back foot in the field, grappling with missed opportunities and an overall lackluster performance. Aayan Khan emerged as the lone warrior among the bowlers, maintaining his line and length while putting in an impressive display. Unfortunately, the rest of the bowling unit struggled to contain the Afghan onslaught, conceding runs without adhering to the game plan. As the teams switch roles, UAE faces a daunting chase against Afghanistan's formidable bowling attack. With history on the line, the UAE must navigate the challenge posed by Afghanistan's skilled bowlers to script a memorable comeback. Will the UAE batsmen rise to the occasion and make tonight historic, or will Afghanistan's bowling prowess prove insurmountable?

And with that spectacular display of power-hitting and batting prowess, we conclude the first innings of this enthralling T20 encounter between Afghanistan and United Arab Emirates. Afghanistan, having been put in to bat first, showcased a batting masterclass, amassing a commanding total of 203 runs in their allotted 20 overs while losing only three wickets. The standout performer of the innings was Rahmanullah Gurbaz, who left an indelible mark with a breathtaking century. Gurbaz's scintillating knock of 100 runs off just 52 deliveries, adorned with 7 boundaries and 7 towering sixes, not only propelled him to his maiden T20 century but also set the stage on fire. Alongside him, the Afghanistan skipper, Ibrahim Zadran, contributed significantly with a splendid half-century, finishing his innings on 59 off 43 balls. The dynamic duo's exceptional partnership held the key to Afghanistan's imposing total on a pitch that appeared tailor-made for the batters.

Commentary.Commentary: We are all set to begin! The players are already out in the middle now. Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Hazratullah Zazai are the two openers for Afghanistan. Muhammad Jawadullah has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's play...

Ibrahim Zadran, the captain of Afghanistan says he would have chosen to bowl first because it's a new surface and it would be very interesting to see the pitch. He continues that in the dressing room, they planned to bowl first but now they have to continue with batting. He says he would like to take two or three wickets in the early stage of the match and their primary target is to score 160-170 to give a challenging target to their opposition.

Muhammad Waseem, the skipper of United Arab Emirates says that the wicket looks good and they will want to bowl first as the wicket is going to stay the same throughout the game. Bowling has been their strength and they would want to capitalise on the opportunity and restrict Afghanistan to somewhere around the 130 mark and look to chase down the total. He finishes by saying that 2 players are making their debuts in the side.

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Hazratullah Zazai, Ibrahim Zadran (C), Azmatullah Omarzai, Mohammad Nabi, Najibullah Zadran, Karim Janat, Qais Ahmad, Noor Ahmad, Naveen-ul-Haq, Fazalhaq Farooqi.

United Arab Emirates (Playing XI) - Muhammad Waseem (C), Khalid Shah, Vriitya Aravind, Tanish Suri (WK & On Debut), Basil Hameed, Samal Udawaththa, Ali Naseer, Aayan Khan, Nilansh Keswani (On Debut), Muhammad Jawadullah, Junaid Siddique.
TOSS - United Arab Emirates have won the toss and elected to BOWL first.

On the other hand, the United Arab Emirates were recently really good in the ICC Men's T20 World Cup Asia Qualifier Final, but they parted ways from it after they faced the loss against Nepal in the 2nd Semi-Final. They need to chin up and look forward to this match, and make a statement after winning the first match of this series. Muhammad Waseem from the top order and Basil Hameed from the middle order are on the list for batters to watch because of their recent performance. From the bowling department, Nilansh Keswani and Ali Naseer will be the two wheels of the chariot with their exquisite spells to dismiss the Afghan batters. Will UAE take their redemption of all these years? Or will the Afghans keep on dominating their side? Stay tuned to find the answers with us! Toss and team updates to follow.

Afghanistan are ready to muscle up their opposition in this three-match T20 series. The Afghans are already dominating by leading the head-to-head for 8 wins out of 10 matches. The most recent series between these two teams took place in February of this year, where Afghanistan outfoxed the Arabs by winning the three-match T20 series 2-1. Ibrahim Zadran will be leading his team from the front and would like to partner up with Azmatullah Omarzai to keep the pressure on the opposition's bowler. Mark on the most experienced player on the pitch, Mohammad Nabi, a lethal allrounder, having an average of 69.5 from the recent matches. From the bowling unit Karim Janat and Fazalhaq Farooqi are really economical and can create a problem for their opponent.

Hello and a warm welcome to our coverage of the 1st T20 in the Afghanistan tour of the United Arab Emirates. The hosts, United Arab Emirates will take on the visiting Afghanistan side for the first time in this three-match match T20 series at the Sharjah Cricket Stadium.
... MATCH DAY ...

Sharjah is set to come alive as the UAE warmly welcomes Afghanistan for an eagerly anticipated cricket series as the teams reunite once again this year for a 3-match T20I series, all to be played at the same venue. Leading Afghanistan will be the talented Ibrahim Zadran who is well known for his aggressive batting approach. Rahmanullah Gurbaz alongside his teammates Rahmat Shah and Najibullah Zadran will be executing their batting duties. With superstar Rashid Khan and Mujeeb absent, Afghanistan's bowling attack will rely on the capable shoulders of Karim Janat, the match winner of the previous series, along with the fearless duo of Naveen-ul-Haq and Fazalhaq Farooqi. Qais Ahmad and Noor Ahmad will be their preferred spinners. Mohammad Nabi, the chief veteran, will aim to fulfil his responsibilities as an all-rounder. The UAE, on the other hand, places its hopes on skipper and opener Muhammad Waseem to provide a solid start at the top of the order. His composed yet aggressive batting style holds the potential to be crucial. Partnering him will be Basil Hameed and the talented Vriitya Aravind who has performed phenomenally in the UAE's domestic cricket in recent years. Both the squads boast a few new faces, adding an element of intrigue to how the series unfolds for them. This T20 series offers a significant opportunity for both teams as Afghanistan is eager to showcase its skills against a quality opposition. For the UAE, the advantage of playing at home provides an opportunity to surprise their more favoured rivals. Afghanistan are riding high on confidence after a tremendous World Cup campaign and the hosts UAE, will boast their home advantage. Anticipate thrilling cricket action as these two spirited teams script another exciting chapter in their growing rivalry. With world-class talent on display, the UAE vs Afghanistan series promises to be a must-watch event for cricket enthusiasts in Sharjah and beyond! Will Afghanistan secure the series and repeat what they did earlier this year, or will the UAE stun the world with their performance? There's much at stake.
